rows.quote: The LTS120 Peltier system includes an easy to use temperature control microscope stage that uses a 40mm x 40mm element to control the temperature of your sample which is mounted on a regular microscope slide and can be moved 15mm in both X and Y directions.

Cryogenic milling is not a function of this instrument.
